Callout.Name: Street Dealing - Group
Callout.Message: Group dealing in the open on a corner.
Callout.Advisory: Three or four suspects, one keeping watch.

Script.Line: We are not selling anything. We are stood here.
It is a public corner. Anybody can stand on a corner.
You have got nothing on me and you know it.

Lines.Approach: Four of them and one watching the corner. They will scatter when they see you.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
